question: Which of the following is correctly paired?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Cyanide ion - CN__⁻**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cyanide ions** are chemical compounds that are fast-acting poisons with a chemical formula CN⁻.
 
• Cyanides consist of one nitrogen atom and a carbon atom connected to each other with a triple bond.</li&g
